source_contributions.scope: The IUBMB Enzyme Commission hierarchy: enzyme entries point to sub-subclasses, sub-subclasses to subclasses, and subclasses to classes. Class-level EC nodes have no parent. A relationship is present only where the immediate parent EC node exists; entries with missing sub-subclass headings lack a parent relationship.
source_contributions.description: ExplorEnz supplies the parent–child relationships of the EC classification.
